module: Flowgraph node 'Simple Cam Path' (once_f_duration category, file cameraPath). Starts a camera path (.camPath.json file designated by 'pathName') via the manager's camera module, with option 'loop'. Outputs: path id, impulse 'activated' on start, 'inactive' if the path is no longer active, 'duration'. The duration state goes to 'finished' when the path is complete.
notes: legacyPins point to 'complete' and 'flow', pins that do not exist in the current schema.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

postInit.desc: Restricts the pathName pin to '.camPath.json' files.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets activatedFlag and the duration state to 'inactive'.

workOnce.desc: Finds the path (camera:findPath), starts it (startPath), writes id, activated=true and goes to the 'started' state.

work.desc: During the started state: handles the activated impulse, sets inactive/duration depending on whether the path is active, goes to 'finished' when isPathComplete.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the middle of the node (empty).

_onDeserialized.desc: Migrates the old field data.loop to the hard-coded pin 'loop'.
